goal: Recover independently documented butterfly larval host-use followed by identified adult or parasitoid emergence; ascertain whether a multi-taxon ecological endpoint can be tested rather than recycling plant-distribution proxies.

source.site: iNaturalist Caterpillar Rearing Group (CRG) project, South Africa and wider Afrotropical region
source.journal_2026_summary: 9,519 rearings, 3,040 Lepidoptera species, 2,031 host plants over project history; THESE ARE PROJECT-REPORTED TOTALS, NOT ASSERTED TO BE AVAILABLE AS iNAT API SOURCE RECORDS
source.historical_peer_reviewed_archive: Staude et al. (2020), Metamorphosis 31(3), historical ~11,628 compiled records; not automatically available in the iNat project API

prespecified_sample.project_resolution: exact slug caterpillar-rearing-group via public iNaturalist project metadata
prespecified_sample.deduplication: unique public iNaturalist observation id, then unique observer×CRG Ref No. when nonblank
prespecified_sample.sampling_limits: If total records exceed sampled volume, only report pilot coverage; no inference about missing taxa or failed rearings.

valid_butterflies.source: CRG Family observation field, with exact LepTraits 239-butterfly taxonomy as a secondary source for in-panel species

independent_larval_use: CRG Caterpillar URL or original iNaturalist larval stage/photo
confirmed_adult_emergence: CRG Date of Emergence as parsable date
CRG Moth/Butterfly URL matching a public original observation, or explicit adult photo in same rearing observation
required_fields.locality_management: CRG Locality/habitat may mention garden/cultivated, but cannot infer origin from unspecified habitat.

stage1_decision.feasibility_pass: At least 30 source-referenced and nonduplicated butterfly rearing events with exact host plant species, at least five butterfly species, at least two host plant families, and adult emergence or parasitoid emergence recorded.
stage1_decision.secondary: At least 5 distinct original 239-butterfly panel species and at least 10 explicitly parasitoid (not all necessarily in panel); report separately. If missing, fail those branches independently.
stage1_decision.attrition_gate: Counts of observed collected larvae with UNKNOWN outcome are required before estimating survival/parasitism percentages; without denominators, report ONLY occurrence of realized success/failure, not relative probabilities.
stage1_decision.stop: If butterfly sample too small or outcome fields too sparse, close CRG route without retuning API pages or substituting moths as butterfly evidence.

quality_boundaries: CRG provides actual lab rearings, not local field population persistence or colonization.
Adult emergence after collection is not evidence of positive growth or absence of natural-enemy cost in nature.
Do not assume all 9,519 historical rearings are accessible in public iNaturalist records.
Outcome-selected project reports may have severe rearing-success and taxonomic selection biases.
No native/exotic status without geographically matched botanical distributions.
No new confirmed butterfly-host edges until original source URLs and taxonomic matches are validated.
Main GEB paper untouched; exploratory analysis branch only.
